fusions.name: Up the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Throws a hidden blade that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Between the Ribs
fusions.desc: A short thrust that deals 20 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds and makes it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Main-Gauche
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Closer Than Remembered
fusions.desc: Conjures a blade that is always in reach. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your dodge chance by 3%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
